member.name: T:SharpHook.R3.IR3GlobalHook
member.summary: Represents a reactive R3 global keyboard and mouse hook.

remarks.para: All observables of objects of this interface are completed when the object is disposed.
It is highly recommended to extend the class if you want to implement this inteface as it correctly implements the invariants required for advanced scenarios.
